messages:
maya: Morning all — quick standup. Queue is 42 right now: 3 P1s, 8 P2s, a few customer follow-ups. P1s: #4532 (auth failure), #4599 (dedicated perf regress), #4601 (billing duplicate charge). I'm taking #4532 until 10:30 PT. Anyone pick up the second P1?

jason: I'll take #4599 after I wrap the CR I'm on. ETA ~11:00.

support-bot: AUTO: Created INC-2024-78 for ticket #4532. Escalation notified to eng-oncall.

liam: Quick note — queue spike seems tied to a retry loop from our webhook consumer, I'm checking routing configs. If it's a routing issue I can push a short hotfix.

sarah: Blocker on #4601 — customer can't repro locally, need full request+response and timestamps from them. @anita can you ask for logs + payment processor TX IDs?

anita: On it. Messaged customer for logs and asked for the earliest failed timestamp. Will post when I have it.

maya: Also updated the refund macro (name: refund-billing). Small change: include idempotency note and example response. If you edit macros, pls ping #support-macros. Snippet:
```
/macro refund-billing
Steps:
1) verify charge id
2) issue refund via payments-console
3) add case note with refund id
```

jason: FYI CRs waiting: reduce-queue-batch (jason) needs review — marking it cr-awaiting-review. If you can spare 10 min, that'd help with throughput.

liam: I'll take afternoon handoff. Covering pager from 17:00 UTC — tag me for anything >P2.

maya: Thanks team. Quick rule: flag any ticket >48h without owner with :triage_flag: and we'll redistribute. I'll post midday queue snapshot at 12:00 PT.

anita: Added PR link to macro update and tests. Leaving a note in the macro PR for reviewers.

sarah: Thx — I'll try to reproduce #4601 again once we get logs.

maya: Closing out — if anything urgent ping me DMs. :thumbsup:
